I will extract the age information by parsing the supplementary PDF, which likely contains detailed context and figures. We can scan for numbers indicating age and use that as the minimum age.

```python
import requests
from io import BytesIO
from PyPDF2 import PdfReader

url = "https://research.aber.ac.uk/files/50806586/sciadv.abi8620_sm.pdf"
resp = requests.get(url)
resp.raise_for_status()
pdf_stream = BytesIO(resp.content)
reader = PdfReader(pdf_stream)
text = "\n".join(page.extract_text() or "" for page in reader.pages)

# Find lines mentioning ka (thousands of years)
import re
matches = re.findall(r"(?:~|ca\.|approx\.?|about)?\s*(\d{2,3})\s*ka", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
print("Found ka mentions:", matches[:10])

# Print a snippet around one occurrence
snippet_idx = text.lower().find("ka")
print("Snippet:", text[snippet_idx-200:snippet_idx+200])
```
